attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους». That is one day before the 16 iulie the folder's Romanian row carries off doxologia: the two calendars keep him a day apart, each row records its own source, and nothing is moved. The man is the folder's own — the martyr of the Diocletian persecution whom doxologia calls Avudin — and the Greek page adds the island of Tenedos as his home, the beating, the tearing of his sides with iron claws, his one answer «Είμαι Χριστιανός», I am a Christian, and his beheading. It gives no year: «στον τότε διωγμό κατά της Εκκλησίας επί Διοκλητιανού», the persecution under Diocletian and no date for it, so the folder's `dates`, read off doxologia as 303-305, are left as they stand and nothing is proposed for them. He is not `eudemus-of-georgia` or `vadim-of-persia`, which the name sweep raised: both carry other names on other days. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.
